svg.title: Store KV outside the GPU, then restore it
svg.desc: Three swap stages: copy B’s eight KV slots from GPU to CPU, release two GPU blocks only after the copy completes, and restore the KV into two blocks when GPU space becomes available. The history p0 through p6, x0, and x1 is retained. A third block is allocated to process x1, producing nine KV slots and the new output x2.
svg.text: Store KV outside the GPU, then restore it
An alternative to recomputation from the same state: transfer the KV values already computed.

g.text: The token history is also retained
x1 was delivered; its KV is not computed yet

svg.text: Computed KV is stored outside the GPU, restored to the GPU, and then used to process the next input.
